
```{r}
source("03_scripts/01_functions.R")
```

## Plotting Defaults

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```


# Import Data

## RTS

```{r}
rts_pt <- read_sf("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson")
```

## Domain

```{r}
domain <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_clean.geojson")
```

## NaturalEarth

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  select(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
```

```{r}
crop_poly <- tibble(
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 90)), crs = 'EPSG:4326')
) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt)) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 5250000) %>%
  smoothr::densify(n = 3) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:4326')

crop_bbox <- crop_poly |>
  st_transform(6931) |>
  st_bbox()

long_lines <- seq(-180, 180, by = 60) %>%
  map(
    ~ long_lines_from_coords(.x, lat_min = st_bbox(crop_poly)[2], lat_max = 90)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

lat_lines <- seq(50, 90, by = 10) %>%
  map(~ lat_lines_from_coords(.x, lon_min = -180, lon_max = 180)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
russia <- world |>
  filter(name == "Russia") |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(id = 1:n())

# West Wrangell Island is 29, East Wrangell Island is 31
russia$geometry[29] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[29], dist = 0.11)
russia$geometry[31] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[31], dist = 0.11)

russia <- russia |>
  select(-id)

russia <- russia |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(russia),
    .by = c(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
  )

world <- world |>
  filter(name != "Russia") |>
  rbind(russia)


world_north <- world %>%
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(crop_poly) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt))
```

# Map RTS (First Look)

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    color = "transparent",
    fill = "gray70"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = domain,
    color = "black",
    fill = "gray95",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_pt,
    color = "darkred",
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```

# RTS Clustering

## Chi-squared Test
```{r}
# set up a point pattern (spatstat) dataset with the domain as the window
(rts_pt_pattern <- c(
  domain |>
    st_as_sfc(),
  rts_pt |>
    st_geometry()
) |>
  as.ppp())

### This test is a bit slow (a few minutes), so only re-run as necessary
```

## Nearest Neighbor Distances

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = rts_pt,
  aes(x = nn_dist_km)
) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count) / sum(after_stat(count)))) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Nearest Neighbor Distance (km)",
    transform = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Count",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
    labels = scales::percent
  )
```


# RTS Regions
This section creates RTS regions (spatially contiguous hotspot and coldspot regions) using the SKATER (Spatial 'K'luster Analysis by Tree Edge Removal) algorithm. Since RTS count is the attribute of interest for this clustering, I have first gridded the entire region and extracted RTS counts.

## Gridded RTS Counts

```{r}
rts_grid <- rts_grid |>
  st_join(rts_pt) |>
  summarise(
    rts_count = n(),
    .by = geometry
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rts_count_log10 = log10(rts_count),
    .after = rts_count
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  rts_grid |>
    filter(RTSCount > 1),
  aes(x = RTSCount)
) +
  geom_histogram()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_grid,
    aes(color = RTSCount, fill = RTSCount)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis(
    name = "RTS Count",
    trans = "log10"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```

## SKATER

```{r}
rts_regions <- skater(
  rts_grid,
  attrs = c("rts_count_log10"),
  weights = "rook",
  n_regions = 1,
  bridge_islands = TRUE,
  seed = 42
)
```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_north) +
  # geom_sf(
  #   data = rts_grid,
  #   aes(color = RTSCount, fill = RTSCount)
  # ) +
  # scale_color_viridis(
  #   name = "RTS Count",
  #   trans = "log10"
  # ) +
  # scale_fill_viridis(
  #   name = "RTS Count",
  #   trans = "log10"
  # ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = rts_regions,
    aes(color = .region, fill = .region)
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_north,
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = crop_poly,
    color = "black",
    fill = "transparent"
  ) +
  # coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```
